verdict.rationale: Unity's packages and docs are versioned: package manuals are pinned to versions such as com.unity.ai.assistant@2.20 and com.unity.ai.inference@2.4, and the UPM registry resolves version metadata like 2.20.0-pre.1. Unity's CLI docs also explicitly flag the in-editor MCP server as deprecated in favor of the CLI, which shows deprecations are announced. Missing for 10: a documented, general deprecation policy (timelines, support windows, versioning guarantees for scripting APIs), any stability/compatibility commitment, and independent corroboration.
